packageRules.description: Cooldown applies hardest to npm — active worm era (research/05)
GitHub Actions: pin to digest, never tags

Automerge safe updates: devDependencies patch/minor (still behind the 7-day npm cooldown above). The automerge/ branch prefix is what the changeset guard exempts (a slash cannot occur in a Renovate branch topic, so it cannot collide with a package name); a runtime occurrence of the same package lands on a separate renovate/ branch
Automerge SHA-pinned GitHub Actions digest bumps only; Docker base-image digests stay ordinary PRs that need a changeset and a release
